text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head to the roof after receiving an
invitation
from Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Inhale... Exhale... And soon, when Trainer arrives...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
W-wait a moment! You're far too early!
This
means...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It's time for take two!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Take two.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, you've arrived, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Um... Well...
choice_data_list: どうしたんだ、プリンセス？
どうしたの、プリンセス？

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: T-t-today... Today, um, uh...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...What was my next line again?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Okay, take three!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ahem!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "Oh, you've arrived, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Are you aware of what day it is today?
February
is the season of sweet
memories..."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes! Valentine's Day! Therefore...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Please accept this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her face tinged with a bright-red hue,
Kawakami
Princess hands me a cutely
wrapped box.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Y-you're welcome! S-so...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Um... About my Valentine's Day gift...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Did I follow proper etiquette as I
handed it to
you?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I did a bunch of research so that I could
do
everything right today!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
First of all, the type of sweets you gift
someone
will change the meaning. I
think the timing also
matters too...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
True elegance means always choosing
the most
appropriate course of action.
Even when giving a
gift to a close
associate, I must strive for that
ideal...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
B-but if I mess up, the person receiving
the gift
won't be as happy as if I did it
correctly...
choice_data_list: そんなこと気にしなくてもいいのに

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list: その気持ちだけで充分嬉しいよ

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: O-of course! Please go ahead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I unwrap Kawakami Princess's gift to find

chocolates from a famous store I often
read
about on the internet.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Well, I wanted to make you
really happy.
choice_data_list: ……たくさん準備してくれたんだな
……たくさん準備してくれたんだね

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stuff my face with chocolate as
Kawakami
Princess watches.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh—hold on! May I ask you to wait just a

moment?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
There's one more thing that I, um, would
like to
do.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No... Or at least, it wasn't mentioned
anywhere in
the stuff I read...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Um, apparently there's a trick to putting
your
feelings into handmade sweets,
which makes them
taste even better.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I made sure to do so when I was making
them,
but... I'm worried about the result.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Can I try putting my feelings into them
once
more before you eat? I know this
hardly makes
for good manners, but...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you! Here goes, then... Hear
my words,
gift of chocolate!
choice_data_list: もちろん、お願いしてもいい？

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Captivate my trainer's taste buds! Your
princess
commands it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Th-that should do it. ...Please enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Urged on by a strangely nervous
Kawakami
Princess, I lift a cupcake out
of the box and take
a bite.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Gulp!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess she's not very used to making
food for
others. The taste inside my
mouth fluctuates
between a burnt
bitterness and the sweetness of
unmixed
sugar.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, truly?! Hehe, I'm so glad that
you like
it. ♪
choice_data_list: 想いが込められてて、すごく美味しいよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I give Kawakami
Princess some
sweets I made for her in
return.
